sourceNotes: This pass started from https://cannabis.ny.gov/ on 2026-09-08 and stayed on that host. Know the Law still states that cannabis is legal for adults 21+. Adult-Use lists licensed dispensaries. Adult-Use Information answers home cultivation, park and outdoor-public smoking bans, and the private-business consumption exception. The patients page answers medical possession, dispensary purchase, and medical home grow. Three stored paths are 404s: /adult-use-personal-home-cultivation, /medical-cannabis-program, and /medical-cannabis-home-cultivation. Cannabis Showcase Event permits are off-site sales, not on-site consumption. The licensing page says future windows for on-site consumption licenses are anticipated, so on-site stays NO. Home-cultivation PDFs on this host were not cited. cannabis.ny.gov answers 403 to fetch and to headless Chromium; the audit then opens a headed window, which loads the pages. A spoofed Chrome user-agent on bundled Chromium keeps the interstitial up, so the browser retry uses Playwright's own identity and reuses one context.
